title: A-2000 assembly & design review
registerRevision: 2026-09-10 · Physical equipment ownership and complete Explore assemblies
lead: Water recovery: RO feed equalization T-2001 with feed / backwash pump P-2001, pretreatment MMF-2001 → GF-2001 → CF-2001 → UF-2001, high-pressure pumps P-2002 and single-pass RO-2001 (modelled as three trains A / B duty, C standby), permeate storage T-2002 with distribution pump P-2005 and polishing CF-2002, concentrate storage T-2003 / P-2003, antiscalant T-2004 / P-2004, CIP skid CIP-2001 and the model-side UF, backwash and spent-CIP buffers, tie-in station BL-A2000 and control station CP-2000.

findings.status: No basis approved — follows the A-1000 case
findings.reason: An RO plant is sized on its feed flow and quality and on the permeate demand; neither is fixed until the A-1000 discharge route and acid-recovery case are decided.
findings.observation: D-A2000-01 withdraws the RO-2001 feed basis and approves only the design statement that A-2000 sizing follows the acid-recovery decision (REP-039) and the A-1000 discharge route: the process-water demand build-up gives 8–18 m³/h net permeate (REP-008) against 17–120 m³/h of A-1000 effluent by case (REP-038). PFD-2000 has no stream table. The model's T-2001 1,000 m³, T-2002 140 m³ and T-2003 95 m³ are screening allowances, and the three RO trains A / B / C with P-2002 A / B / C exist only in the model — LST-001 and PFD-2000 list one RO-2001 and one P-2002.
findings.action: Decide the A-1000 case, then issue the first A-2000 stream table on DBM V2.0 with the recovery, permeate quality and concentrate route; reconcile the three-train configuration with LST-001 / PFD-2000.

findings.topic: RO feed condition — oxidiser, scaling and the NaOH question
findings.reason: The RO membrane tolerates neither residual oxidiser nor a feed beyond its sulphate scaling limit; the upstream chemistry decides whether RO is workable at all.
findings.observation: D-A2000-02 approves REP-038 as the process constraint: RO feed must be oxidiser-free and within BaSO₄ / CaSO₄ scaling limits; lime-stage gypsum saturation (≈ 1,480 mg/L) governs recovery; no NaOH upstream, because Na₂SO₄ at 61 g/L makes RO unworkable — which ties this area to the A-1000 flowsheet decision. P-2002 is approved as a 12–16 bar high-pressure pump (MAT-002 service register) as a screening basis. The model provides carbon filtration CF-2001 for oxidant / organic reduction and antiscalant dosing T-2004 / P-2004 ahead of the trains.
findings.action: Carry the oxidiser-free and scaling constraints into the A-1000 MoC (lime-first, no NaOH) and into the RO design basis; confirm the antiscalant and recovery against the gypsum limit once the feed is fixed.

findings.reason: Multimedia, greensand, carbon and ultrafiltration protect the RO; their backwash and filtrate handling return to A-1000 and must be sized with it.
findings.observation: The model provides the register pretreatment train MMF-2001 / GF-2001 / CF-2001 (parallel-vessel allowances) and a dead-end UF-2001 with two backwash banks, plus the model-only UF filtrate / backwash buffer TK-UF2001 with pump P-UF2001, the backwash collection TK-BW2001 with lift pump P-BW2001 to A-1000 and the control station CP-2000. None of the model-only tags is on LST-001; no filtration duty is approved.
findings.action: Size the pretreatment on the A-2000 stream table; register TK-UF2001, P-UF2001, TK-BW2001, P-BW2001 and CP-2000 or record them by decision; state the backwash return in the A-1000 balance.

findings.reason: Sequential acid / alkaline cleaning liquor is a segregated waste and must not reach the RO feed or the A-1000 lime stage uncontrolled.
findings.observation: The model provides the register CIP skid CIP-2001 with recirculation pump P-CIP2001, a segregated spent-CIP hold TK-CIP2001-W (5 m³ allowance) with transfer pump P-CIP2001-W, and the antiscalant day tank T-2004 / P-2004. The CIP chemistry, frequency and spent-liquor destination are not defined; the spent-CIP tank and the two CIP pumps (P-CIP2001, P-CIP2001-W) exist only as model geometry without semantic records.
findings.action: Define the CIP chemistry and cycle with the membrane selection; assign the spent-CIP destination (A-1000 stage or off-site); register the model-only tags.

findings.reason: Pretreated, low-solids water at up to 16 bar sets pressure-vessel and pump materials; the membranes themselves are a selection, not a material ruling.
findings.observation: D-A2000-MOC applies MAT-002 to fourteen items with the RO service row — TFC polyamide RO elements in FRP pressure vessels, with the matching tank, pump, filter-housing and CIP selections; MDL-001 (HDPE / XLPE tanks, 316L pumps and housings, PVDF UF modules) superseded. The single MAT-002 row covers the whole area, so the tank and pump wording is generic and will need item-level refinement at datasheet stage.
findings.action: Refine MAT-002 per item (tanks, pumps, filter housings, UF modules) once the stream table exists; keep the TFC / FRP RO selection.

decisions.rationale: Plant-wide ruling: FEED-PE-MAT-002 'Recommended MOC (base case)' governs material of construction over FEED-PE-MDL-001 (scale-up study) and design-note wording — MAT-002 is the controlled MoC matrix and postdates MDL-001. Wording variants of the same material family are superseded by the MAT-002 statement.
8–18 m³/h net permeate (REP-008, demand build-up) vs 17–120 m³/h A-1000 effluent by case (REP-038): feed and product bases not reconciled; PFD-2000 has no stream table.
decisions.gapNote: Decide the A-1000 discharge route and the spent-acid recovery case (REP-039: 150–200 t/d reconcentration; MOC-001 Part D.1) before any A-1000 / A-2000 sizing; then issue the first A-1000 / A-2000 stream tables (none exist) on DBM V2.0 with the wastewater range by case (REP-038).

decisions.rationale: A-2000 sizing follows the acid-recovery decision and the A-1000 discharge route — do not freeze.

RO feed must be oxidiser-free and within BaSO₄ / CaSO₄ scaling limits; gypsum saturation ≈ 1,480 mg/L governs recovery; no NaOH upstream (Na₂SO₄ 61 g/L makes RO unworkable) — adopted as the process constraint.
12–16 bar high-pressure pump (MAT-002 M-061 service register) — screening basis.
decisions.gapNote: Reconcile the model's three RO trains (RO-2001A/B/C, P-2002A/B/C) and the backwash / UF / CIP sub-package tags with LST-001 / PFD-2000 once the A-2000 stream table exists.
